name: Fabi.ai
tagline: AI data-analysis notebooks that turn questions into dashboards.
description: Fabi.ai is an AI-native analytics platform built around Smartbooks — reactive notebooks that blend SQL, Python, and natural-language querying. Analysts ask a question and Fabi generates the query, chart, or workflow, then turns the result into a shareable dashboard or scheduled report. It connects to warehouses like Snowflake, BigQuery, and Redshift.
insight: Raised a $3M seed in 2023 led by Eniac Ventures; pitched as an AI-native Jupyter and Google Colab alternative for data teams.
edge: Pairs reactive SQL + Python notebooks with natural-language AI, so an ad-hoc question becomes a shareable dashboard without leaving one tool.
cons: Aimed at data teams, not pure non-technical users
Younger product with a smaller ecosystem
Premium connectors gated to paid plans
